summary: Redirect to a playlist file URL
description: Returns an HTTP 302 redirect to the requested playlist file. The endpoint does not return a JSON payload; instead it redirects to the actual audio file. Only the mp3 format is currently supported. Invalid requests result in HTTP 404 or 500 errors.

parameters.name: client_id
parameters.description: Client identifier provided by Jamendo developer portal.

parameters.name: audioformat
parameters.description: Audio format for the returned file URL. Currently only 'mp3' (192kbps) is supported.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: Playlist identifier for which to retrieve the file.

notes: The endpoint issues an HTTP redirect (302) to the actual media file; no JSON body is returned.
If the playlist does not exist, a 404 error is returned.
Malformed requests result in a 500 error with error details in the response headers.
